quality_profile: All applicable current repository gates, provenance/rights/security review, native independent Code Owner approval, defect dispositions, deterministic lossless history checks and fresh exact-head readback. A versioned profile must enumerate them; no unmeasured universal quality maximum is asserted.
inventory_rule: Bind every initial PR/head/ref and the complete final census. Pagination or ref-list truncation, concurrent inventory drift, or omitted refs prevents acceptance. Reobserve the whole collection after every selected effect.
lossless_rule: Every bound original head/tip and its Git object closure must remain reachable from the resulting role-local Main. A squash, equal tree, branch deletion, closed-unmerged PR or self-reported retained flag is insufficient.
reciprocal_rule: Bind source and target repository, authenticated actual executor, exact source head, target before/after, accepted EFFECT_ACK chain and post-effect readback for each direction. One-way execution is insufficient.
proof_rule: Freeze the closed software heads before publishing an evidence bundle. Receipts bind those immutable inputs and subsequent observations; never claim an in-file hash of its own containing commit. Fresh gates do not transfer across later head changes.
publication_rule: Repository, current public IETF specification and Zenodo artifacts require public byte-exact readback. Any new publication uses existing candidate-bound single-use proof-bearing publication contracts; the target declaration is not proof of its achievement.
controller_rule: One smallest admitted effect per step, fresh observation afterwards, idempotent replay or forward repair after ambiguous effects. No force, self-approval, permission widening or gate bypass.
